priority: P1 — proteger /dupla campo como recuperação do painel 2v2: reutilizar a sessão existente, validar servidor de origem, republicar no canal atual, invalidar a revisão pública antiga e só remover da fila de atualização após markTagPublished confirmar a mesma revisão.

behavior.flow: currentTag(owner) -> validate original guild -> runTagBots(existing.id) -> visualTagPublic -> setTagMessage(existing.id,newMessage,currentChannel) -> markTagPublished(existing.id,revision)
behavior.recovery: setTagMessage resets public_revision to -1; dueTags requeues the active session; stale markTagPublished revision is ignored; exact revision clears the queue.
behavior.persistence: Existing session, member lock, revision, state and physical card UIDs remain unchanged; only message/channel/public_revision are updated.

testCoverage: Verifies /dupla campo is registered and uses the existing player session.
Verifies public channel reply and visualTagPublic/setTagMessage/markTagPublished handler contract.
Uses temporary SQLite with an actual TagDuel state and member lock.
Publishes an initial message, then simulates a lost message and recovery in a new channel.
Confirms dueTags requeues the session until the exact revision is marked published.
Confirms stale publication revision cannot clear a newer panel.
Confirms no second session or member lock is created and duel revision/state are unchanged.
Validates public/private Discord payload builders offline.

security.discord: handler contract + builders offline; sem token/guild/canal real

limitations: Não instancia Client Discord nem publica em guild/canal real; a integração do handler é protegida por contrato de source e a persistência é exercitada via TagStore.
Não altera runtime, catálogo, certificações ou dados de jogadores.
